mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a temperature of 50 degrees near Fireman's Park under a Waning Gibbous moon. The International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 6:38 AM, rising over Middleton near Verona High School and traveling toward the east over Fitchburg, peaking halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona is keeping up with infrastructure through ongoing contract reports with AECOM, and the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is hosting public meetings on November 18 and 19 regarding the US 18/151 Corridor Study to gather community input on new design concepts.

Today, you can enjoy music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, tomorrow features the Main Street Trick or Treat and Thursday Night Art House events, while live music continues later this week at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee.
On October 21, officers and local emergency services responded to two separate cardiac arrest calls on Batker Court and Basswood Avenue, providing life-saving assistance at both scenes.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM. Make sure to stop by before they close at 10:00 PM tonight.
